1: The real natue is acquired by the firm stay in the pre-eminent saftasa.
2: The flow of operations (becomes) all of a sudden saturated, as it were, with the acquisition of that.
3: Entry into the great vacuity results from the bursting open of the two boards.
4: The firm stay in the universal consciousness is brought about by the destruction of the couple.
5: The great union arises from the unification of the siidhayoginls.
6: The inexpressible stage appears on the abandonment of the three veils.
7: In all the manifestations of appearance and disappearance of the four forms of utterance, the sound alone glories.
8: On the enjoyment of the triple happiness, the unfettered supreme Brahman of the involuntary and sudden appearance (comes to revelation).
9: Permanence of the immersion in the real self takes place for ever by the full development of the four deities. The four deities.
10: The play of the big rays follows the emanation of the twelve currents.
11: On the full play of the five functions, the ungraded inspiration takes place.
12: Kelease from merit and demerit accompanies the inspiration of the great enlightenment.
13: The attainment of the unity takes place, through the acquisition of the mudra of great wonderment, by virtue of the concentration on the real nature.
